appointments_cancelled.name: appointments_cancelled
appointments_cancelled.value: ("appointments"."cancelled_by" is not null) = ("appointments"."status" = 'cancelled') and ("appointments"."cancelled_at" is not null) = ("appointments"."status" = 'cancelled')

appointments_anonymized.name: appointments_anonymized
appointments_anonymized.value: ("appointments"."anonymized_at" is not null) = ("appointments"."contact_name" is null and "appointments"."contact_email" is null and "appointments"."contact_email_normalized" is null)

appointments_anonymized_rest.name: appointments_anonymized_rest
appointments_anonymized_rest.value: "appointments"."anonymized_at" is null or ("appointments"."reason" is null and "appointments"."contact_phone" is null)

clinic_hero_alt.name: clinic_hero_alt
clinic_hero_alt.value: "clinic"."hero_image_path" is null or "clinic"."hero_image_alt" is not null

clinic_about_alt.name: clinic_about_alt
clinic_about_alt.value: "clinic"."about_image_path" is null or "clinic"."about_image_alt" is not null

discount_codes_range.name: discount_codes_range
discount_codes_range.value: "discount_codes"."starts_at" is null or "discount_codes"."ends_at" is null or "discount_codes"."ends_at" > "discount_codes"."starts_at"

email_outbox_source.name: email_outbox_source
email_outbox_source.value: "email_outbox"."contact_message_id" is not null or "email_outbox"."payload" is not null or "email_outbox"."status" in ('sent', 'failed', 'skipped_rate_limit')

orders_names_len.name: orders_names_len
orders_names_len.value: ("orders"."first_name" is null or char_length("orders"."first_name") between 1 and 60) and ("orders"."last_name" is null or char_length("orders"."last_name") between 1 and 60)

orders_address.name: orders_address
orders_address.value: "orders"."anonymized_at" is not null or "orders"."shipping_kind" = 'clinic_pickup' or ("orders"."address_line" is not null and "orders"."postal_code" is not null and "orders"."city" is not null)

orders_contact.name: orders_contact
orders_contact.value: "orders"."anonymized_at" is not null or ("orders"."contact_email" is not null and "orders"."contact_email_normalized" is not null and "orders"."first_name" is not null and "orders"."last_name" is not null)

orders_cancelled.name: orders_cancelled
orders_cancelled.value: ("orders"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("orders"."cancelled_at" is not null and "orders"."cancel_reason" is not null and "orders"."cancelled_by" is not null)

schedule_blocks_once.name: schedule_blocks_once
schedule_blocks_once.value:
"schedule_blocks"."kind" <> 'once' or ("schedule_blocks"."starts_at" is not null and "schedule_blocks"."ends_at" is not null and "schedule_blocks"."ends_at" > "schedule_blocks"."starts_at"
        and "schedule_blocks"."from_date" is null and "schedule_blocks"."until_date" is null and "schedule_blocks"."weekdays" is null and "schedule_blocks"."start_time" is null and "schedule_blocks"."end_time" is null)

schedule_blocks_weekly.name: schedule_blocks_weekly
schedule_blocks_weekly.value:
"schedule_blocks"."kind" <> 'weekly' or ("schedule_blocks"."from_date" is not null and "schedule_blocks"."until_date" is not null and "schedule_blocks"."until_date" >= "schedule_blocks"."from_date"
        and "schedule_blocks"."until_date" - "schedule_blocks"."from_date" <= 366
        and "schedule_blocks"."weekdays" is not null and cardinality("schedule_blocks"."weekdays") > 0 and "schedule_blocks"."weekdays" <@ array[1,2,3,4,5,6,7]::smallint[]
        and "schedule_blocks"."start_time" is not null and "schedule_blocks"."end_time" is not null and "schedule_blocks"."end_time" > "schedule_blocks"."start_time"
        and "schedule_blocks"."starts_at" is null and "schedule_blocks"."ends_at" is null)

team_photo_alt.name: team_photo_alt
team_photo_alt.value: "team_members"."photo_path" is null or "team_members"."photo_alt" is not null
